model_scope: synthetic only; holdout actual outcomes excluded

selection.rule: constant primary for every valid theta_star; never select using CAL outcomes
selection.power_bound: minimum one-sided 99% Clopper-Pearson across three scenarios

planning_alternative.admissible: all four eps in (0,0.05], all resulting margins in (0,1)

factor_scopes.cluster: one N(0,1) per parent cluster per repetition
factor_scopes.law: one N(0,1) per law per repetition, shared across gates/arms/checkpoints/episodes
factor_scopes.gate: one N(0,1) per (parent_cluster, gate) per repetition
factor_scopes.arm: one N(0,1) per (law, arm) per repetition
factor_scopes.checkpoint: stationary AR(1) Gaussian per (law, gate, arm), j=0..8
factor_scopes.episode: independent N(0,1) per (law, gate, arm, checkpoint, episode)

binary_joint_generator.latent_formula: U=sum_f sqrt(weight_f)*Z_f; Y=1{Phi(U)<=p_arm,gate,j}; all weights nonnegative and sum to one
binary_joint_generator.slope_solver: minimal kappa[a] in [0,8] matching mean of two G1/G2 trapezoidal AULC differences to Delta_star; 64 bisections; fail if absent or final abs discrepancy >1e-10
binary_joint_generator.aggregation: same Y used for seven AULC differences, G1/B, G2/B, and FULL minus max of all seven control B success rates, all HT weighted; no independent Contrast variable

simulation.prng: HMAC-SHA256 counter PRF with secret owner-escrow CAL seed, domain separated
simulation.uniform_to_normal: registered IEEE754 binary64 inverse Phi version; must digest implementation before CAL
simulation.samples: unique law Sampford PPSWOR / parent cluster bootstrap HT weights
simulation.stop: complete ascending scan; only first admissible n; STOP_UNKNOWN on unavailable model/design/repetitions or MC lower bound below 0.80

digest_contract: SHA-256 of exact stored UTF-8/LF JSON file bytes; lowercase 64hex prefixed sha256:; no self-referential digest field
